notes.title: Game Update.
notes.content: [p]Salam alaikum batyrs and jigitki. 😎[/p][p]We’ve prepared an update for NEED FOR SCREAMM:[/p][p]1. Fixed bugs causing the cat to get stuck.[/p][p]2. Fixed a critical bug related to saving part of the baby crib toy.[/p][p]3. Fixed a visual display bug.[/p][p]4. Improved the behavior of jumpscares.[/p][p]5. Improved monster attack logic.[/p][p]6. Enhanced sound system performance.[/p][p]7. Various minor improvements and fixes.[/p]
